dialogues.speaker: Likhovidova
dialogues.text: Will no one step up? Come now, people of Morepesok! I don't mean to look down on you, you know!

dialogues.speaker: Likhovidova
dialogues.text: The name's Likhovidova, the one who's set up this Snowball Dodge Arena!

dialogues.speaker: Likhovidova
dialogues.text: I used to be an Adventurers' Guild member myself, you know. And there was this one time, when I encountered a pack of Fluffahogs amidst a snowy night on the tundra.

dialogues.speaker: Likhovidova
dialogues.text: They came rolling on, like a cannonball made of giant spikes, and I was left a right sobbing mess by the end of the chase...

dialogues.speaker: Likhovidova
dialogues.text: Having survived this ordeal, I committed myself to training harder, using snowballs during said training to simulate the impact of their charges.

dialogues.speaker: Likhovidova
dialogues.text: Once I succeeded, I would have the agility to humiliate them the next time we met! Hehehe...

dialogues.speaker: Likhovidova
dialogues.text: The rules are simple. Stand in the arena and try to avoid being hit by snowballs. The longer you last, the greater the prize!

dialogues.speaker: Likhovidova
dialogues.text: What do you think? I can see it burning in your eyes — the will of a warrior. Wanna give this a try, then?

choices.text: No, I've got other things to attend to right now...

response.speaker: Likhovidova
response.text: No worries! Just as that flock of Fluffahogs awaits me still amidst the white birches, the Snowball Dodge Arena will always wait for you!

response.speaker: Likhovidova
response.text: It's fate, you know — it's fate that had us meet this way. You'll realize that one day, I'm sure of it.

dialogues.speaker: Likhovidova
dialogues.text: What ingenuity. The way you dodged these snowballs, these simulated monsters... every move was filled with such inventiveness!

dialogues.speaker: Likhovidova
dialogues.text: Ah, what a shame. If we only had a Kamera with us, I could've recorded your various dodging techniques for further study.

dialogues.speaker: Likhovidova
dialogues.text: Here... These are all for you. Ah, if only I had such agility back then. I would've been untouchable, even had those Fluffahogs come rolling on!

dialogues.speaker: Likhovidova
dialogues.text: So, how about it? Got a moment to try out the Snowball Dodge Arena?

choices.text: No, I've got other things to attend to right now...

response.speaker: Likhovidova
response.text: No worries! Just as the Fluffahogs await me amidst the white birches, the Snowball Dodge Arena will always wait for you!

response.text: It's fate, you know — it's fate that had us meet this way. You'll realize that one day, I'm sure of it.
